lessonTitle: 56. Distance between two points; the midpoint of a segment
lessonTitleEnglish: Distance between two points; the midpoint of a segment
unit: Geometry · Chapter III. Coordinates in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The distance between A(x₁; y₁; z₁) and B(x₂; y₂; z₂) is AB = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²).
stages.headlineEnglish: The distance between A(x₁; y₁; z₁) and B(x₂; y₂; z₂) is AB = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²).

stages.headline: The midpoint M of AB has x = (x₁ + x₂)/2, y = (y₁ + y₂)/2, z = (z₁ + z₂)/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: The midpoint M of AB has x = (x₁ + x₂)/2, y = (y₁ + y₂)/2, z = (z₁ + z₂)/2.

stages.headline: Example: A(1; −2; 3), B(5; 2; 5): AB = √(16 + 16 + 4) = 6 and the midpoint is M(3; 0; 4).
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: A(1; −2; 3), B(5; 2; 5): AB = √(16 + 16 + 4) = 6 and the midpoint is M(3; 0; 4).
